tools.name: ledger_create
tools.description: Create a standing-instruction ledger under your account.

tools.name: ledger_compile
tools.description: Compile a standing rule into a signed ledger entry (or a signed residual entry when it cannot compile faithfully).

tools.name: ledger_diff
tools.description: Diff an order against a ledger at intake: CONSISTENT / CONTRADICTS / APPROVAL-REQUIRED / EXPIRED-RULE-INVOKED / OVERRIDE_RECEIPT / CONFIRMATION-REQUIRED. Metered like the HTTP diff.

tools.name: ledger_execute
tools.description: Execute an order: the server independently re-diffs (409 semantics as an error result on contradiction) and returns an attestation naming the ledger version in force.

tools.name: ledger_verify
tools.description: Verify a ledger record's Ed25519 signature against the published keys.

tools.name: ledger_version
tools.description: A ledger's current version (head hash) and chain verification.
